Chapter 5 - Telephone Manager Messages / Telephone Manager Message Reference
Constants

Audible Digit States

The telCADigitsImmMsg and telCADigitsMsg messages provide information about key presses from a remote number. The mtype parameter contains one of the following constants: 
enum {
   telDigitAudible         = 0,
   telDigitNotAudible      = 1
};
Constant descriptions
telDigitAudible
The key press generated an audible tone (that is, in-band DTMF).
telDigitNotAudible
The key press did not generate an audible tone.
